Peptide length distribution: boxplot + count histogram

Source: R/plots.R
plot_peplength.Rd

Peptide length distribution: boxplot + count histogram

Usage

plot_peplength(input, title, ylimits = NULL, xlimits = NULL)

Arguments

input

A pep_all-shaped data frame with a Length column.

title

Plot title.

ylimits, xlimits

Optional length-2 numeric vectors overriding the automatically derived axis limits (count-based ylimits, rounded up to the nearest 1000; length-based xlimits, rounded up to the nearest 10).

Value

A ggpubr-arranged figure (boxplot above a count histogram) with the title annotated above.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_peplength(pep_all, title = "All peptides")
} # }
